entry_state: Contingent options require both the period-end condition and the applicable similar-instrument prerequisite. Participating dividends can alter the ordinary EPS numerator through a hypothetical tax benefit, including a signed reversal when older profits are paid. These allocations create no journal. The chapter now introduces a dated control graph and separate consolidation adjustment book, followed by the more detailed perimeter method.
exit_state: Consolidation retains entity books, dated control findings and matched adjustments. Acquisition, intra-group profit/tax and currency translation have separate rules. The foreign-subsidiary case carries proportionate-NCI goodwill and parent/NCI translation gains through loss of control; both disposal alternatives remove the whole subsidiary, but their cash and retained-investment positions differ. The disposal cash-flow explanation continues next.
findings: Control is not inferred automatically from80% ownership, and reporting-date differences cannot use a generic nearest-date join.
Intercompany profit elimination preserves external tax obligations and distinguishes upstream NCI attribution from a downstream parent sale.
The foreign-subsidiary example explains why goodwill translation belongs entirely to the parent under proportionate NCI, and why cash exchange effect7 differs from OCI12.6.
Loss of control removes all subsidiary balances and recycles the parent's entire reserve even with a retained minority investment. No new confirmed local defect.
